data.one_liner: Adds helper methods to ScrollController for navigating items by index or position.
data.what_it_does: Provides a controller that can scroll to a specific item, to the start or end, and move forward or backward by page. It also exposes flags to check if scrolling is possible and whether the list is at the start or end.
use_when: You need to programmatically jump to a specific item in a list with uniform item height.
You want simple forward/backward or page navigation without writing custom logic.
You need to know if the list is already at the top or bottom to disable buttons or show indicators.
avoid_when: Your list items have varying heights, as the package assumes equal height for accurate calculations.
You prefer a declarative navigation approach using packages like page_transition or smooth_page_indicator for page-based scrolling.
strengths: Supports both vertical and horizontal scrolling.
Provides flags (canScroll, canForward, canBackward, atStart, atEnd) for UI state.
weaknesses: Assumes all items have the same height; otherwise calculations are wrong.
No built‑in support for dynamic item sizes or complex layouts.
Limited to scrolling logic; no visual widgets or theming.
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec and import the package. No build_runner or permissions required.
